The implementation is complete and fully verified. Summary of what I built in `/work/submit`:

**`planb64.cpp`** (single C++17 TU, libc/libstdc++ only, single-threaded, no SIMD):

- **`build`** — strict FIB parsing: exactly two space/tab/CR-separated tokens, `inet_pton(AF_INET6)`-validated address (rejects IPv4-only, zone IDs, CIDR suffixes), digits-only prefix length restricted to 0..64 (`/65`–`/128` are hard errors), digits-only next hop in 0..4294967295, control characters/NULs rejected. Prefixes are normalized (host bits *and* lower 64 bits cleared), duplicates of the same normalized `(network,length)` rejected. The image is compiled from the minimal change-point set `{0} ∪ {starts} ∪ {ends+1}` evaluated with a max-heap sweep of active prefixes (longest wins, lazy interval expiry), so boundaries survive when only the length changes and redundant endpoints are dropped. The destination file is opened **only after** the whole FIB validates and compiles.
- **`lookup`** — canonical image reader rejecting every listed malformation (header/version, unpadded count 1..400001 with count match, exactly 16 lowercase hex keys, first key 0, strictly increasing keys, no equal adjacent pairs, valid ranges / paired `-1 -1` only, exact single-space spacing, no extra records, mandatory final newline) plus full trace validation *before* any byte is printed. Answers come from predecessor binary search, scalar per record or in sorted cache-friendly batches (batch ≡ scalar semantics, sizes 1..256 with leading zeros accepted, non-dividing sizes and empty traces handled).
- All failures: exit **2**, empty stdout, one `ERROR:` line on stderr; success writes nothing to stderr.

**Validation performed:** public example matches byte-for-byte (image + all three lookup invocations); an independent Python reference agreed on ~400 randomized FIB/trace pairs (mixed address spellings, CRLF, blank lines, missing final newline, padding), on structured cases (nested `/0../64` chain, adjacent same-pair prefixes, top-of-space, default-only, empty FIB), and on the maximum cases — 200000 prefixes → 400001-row image (0.11 s) and 1000000 trace records (0.3–0.45 s) under a 512 MiB `RLIMIT_AS`; 143 argument/parse/image/trace error checks; over-limit inputs rejected; failed builds leave the destination untouched/uncreated; clean under `-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Werror` and UBSan (`-fno-sanitize-recover=all`); ASan can't run in this sandbox (no `/proc`), so memory safety was handled via RAII and reviewed manually; `make clean && make` honors `CXX=g++` and externally supplied `CXXFLAGS` from both the environment and the command line.
